head: c26d3fef4710a72b3ca7d0a35afc52357709b5a1
summary:
Build attempt 3 (c26d3fe) does what the send-back asked. It does not change the gap validation could not close before, and no rebuild can close it.

**What changed since 41f82cc.** Only two files outside .taad:
- A doc comment in ShellReveal.cs (Walk's summary now says Exact needs the resolve-back and an S_OK open). The reveal code is otherwise byte-identical, so last validation's real-shell Walk probe (O-015 fix, 161/300/1000 characters, deny-all, D: without 8.3) still describes this product.
- tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 (O-016, O-017).

**Real system, this build:**
- Fresh single-file publish.
- R-002 step (e) passed through the published exe on the live desktop. The app logged Failed / NoLongerExists / 0x80070002 and put "'victim.bin' no longer exists where the scan found it, so Explorer was not opened. Rescan to refresh." on the status line.
- Explorer's Shell.Application list was the same before and after (one pre-existing entry).
- The case fixture was removed.

**Code-level checks:**
- 503/503 tests pass.
- Fitness holds all 69 rules.
- rules-parity AGREEs.
- src has no Process.Start, ShellExecute, explorer.exe or /select. The only reveal caller is MainWindow.xaml.cs:775.

**O-016 and O-017, checked independently.** I loaded the real functions out of WindowCases.ps1 into a fake Shell.Application and ran them under pwsh 7.6.6 and Windows PowerShell 5.1.
- Check-Landing now outputs only its check lines and the 'landed N ms after the click' line. It never outputs a bare number. It records a failure for a 1200 ms landing, for a missing log row and for no landing.
- Close-CaseWindows quits a case window alone, two case tabs alone, and a case window beside a separate window of the person's. It quits nothing when the case tab shares its HWND with a readable tab, a tab with a null Document, a tab whose read fails, or a tab that joins between the count and the recount. It also quits nothing while some entry's HWND is unreadable.

**Still not run: R-002 steps a–d and R-001.** They open Explorer windows on the person's desktop and close them through Shell.Application Quit(), which is operating another program's windows unattended. So criteria 1, 2, 4 and 5 of what the slice owes (design cases 1–7) have still never been seen against real Explorer with any SL-088 build. The script now prints the step, the check and the landing time when something fails.

**This slice is in a loop.** Three builds and three validations have come back partial for the same reason. Build 3 changed src only in a comment. Another rebuild cannot close the gap: a person has to run `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case R-002` and `... -Case R-001`.

**Criterion 14 (Hidden+System) is not met.** The design deferred it, and the spike is still waiting on a person.

checks.what: O-017: Close-CaseWindows quits a case entry only when the raw Shell.Application count under its HWND is the case's own
checks.command: same temp harness: Get-ExplorerWindows, Get-ExplorerHwndCounts, Test-Under and Close-CaseWindows loaded from the AST; New-Object overridden to return a fake Shell.Application whose entries record Quit()
checks.evidence:
Same results in pwsh 7 and PS 5.1.
Quit:
- (1) case window alone: quit, 0 reported.
- (2) two case tabs in one HWND: both quit.
- (7) case window beside the person's separate window: case quit, person's kept.
- (9) control, person's tab joins after the quit: quit.
Not quit, 1 reported, about 5 s wait:
- (3) case tab beside the person's readable tab.
- (4) beside a tab with a null Document.
- (5) beside a tab whose Document read was set to throw.
- (6) case window alone while another entry's HWND is unreadable.
- (8) the person's tab joins the HWND between the count and the recount.
Caveat: PowerShell swallowed the fake ScriptProperty getter's exception; the sanity probe showed no throw reaching try. So shapes 5 and 6 exercised the null-read path ([long]$null goes to the 0 key), not the catch branches. Real COM getters may throw and would then go through those try/catch blocks, which this harness did not reach.

checks.evidence: parse errors 0 in both. Each loaded function is defined exactly once.
69 rules checked against 121 parsed files, 126 read. Every declared rule holds, including the select-switch rule and the no-ancestor-fallback rule. The new ShellReveal comment trips nothing.

criteria.criterion: 1. Short-path folder with a FullControl deny ACE: its readable parent opens with it selected
criteria.how: The real-shell Walk reached the open as Exact for a 73-character deny-all folder at 41f82cc, and the product code is unchanged since then. R-002 (e) re-confirmed on this build that the fixture's deny ACE makes the folder unlistable. The window landing, R-002 (a), was not run.

criteria.criterion: 2. Item at about 161 characters, under MAX_PATH
criteria.how: Walk: Exact at exactly 161 characters on C: and D: (41f82cc, same product code). The window landing, R-002 (b), was not run.

criteria.criterion: 3. File at exactly 300 characters, revealed from its biggest-files row
criteria.how: Walk: Exact at 300 characters on C: (8.3 back) and on D: (\\?\ back). The biggest-files-row landing, R-002 (b), was not run.
Walk: Exact at 1000 characters on C: and D:. The landing, R-002 (d), was not run.

criteria.criterion: 5. Deny-all folder at exactly 300 characters, revealed from its tree row
criteria.how: Walk: Exact on C: and D:. The fixture's deny was re-confirmed unlistable in this run's R-002 (e). The tree-row landing and the dialog/consent watch, R-002 (c), were not run.

criteria.criterion: 6. First reveal of the run, Explorer cold
criteria.how: R-002 runs b first, and Check-Landing now prints the ms and fails over 1000 ms (fake-record harness). The real cold landing time on any SL-088 build is unmeasured. The spikes' slowest was 934 ms, on the old path.

criteria.criterion: 7. Explorer already open on the target's parent with a sibling selected
criteria.how: R-002 (d) was not run. Only the spike (12/12, pre-SL-088 path) covers it.

criteria.criterion: 8. Refuse: target's parent deleted after the scan
criteria.how: R-002 (e) passed through the freshly published c26d3fe exe on the live desktop. The app logged Failed/NoLongerExists/0x80070002 and put the refusal text on the status line. Explorer's window list did not change during or after the run.

criteria.criterion: 9. Refuse: target deleted, parent still exists
criteria.how: The real-tree unit test Walk_OnRealTree_RefusesGoneTargetsAndLandsThePresentOne passes in the 503 run (real parse on an STA thread). The real-shell Walk probe at 41f82cc gave Failed/NoLongerExists with 0 opens, and the product code is unchanged since.

criteria.criterion: 10. Refuse: parse succeeds but SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems fails
criteria.how: Code contact only. Walk_OpenFails_RefusesWithItsCodeFreesTheIdListAndTriesNothingElse passes with a fake shell (503 run). No real open failure was produced.

criteria.criterion: 11. Refuse: parse fails with a code other than not-found
criteria.how: Code contact only. Walk_ParseFailsOtherwise_RefusesWithThatCode passes for 0x80070005, 0x8007007B, 0x80070035 and 0x80004005 with a fake shell.
SelectSwitchRuleTests pass (503 run). Fitness: all 69 rules hold on the clean tree. rules-parity AGREEs.
SelectSwitchRuleTests.TheRuleLeavesLookAlikesAlone passes. 'Open in Explorer' is in the App, and Fitness reports no hit.

Not measured. The spike measured 0/8 H+S selected under this PC's settings, and the default-settings run is still waiting on a person. The product still reports Exact from the shell's answers plus the hidden note. The design deferred this case.

planned.evidence: The product's Walk, with the real SHParseDisplayName and resolve-back, reaches SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems as Exact for deny-all folders at 73 and 300 characters. That was measured at 41f82cc, and the product is unchanged except a comment. The window-side check was not run: R-002 (a)/(c) read Explorer's folder and selection by leaf Name and watch for #32770 and consent.exe. They open Explorer windows and quit them through Shell.Application, which this run may not do.

Walk is Exact at 161/300/1000 characters on C: (8.3) and D: (no 8.3) (41f82cc, same product code). Whether the right leaf is selected in the right parent within 1 s, R-002 (b)/(d), has not been run on any SL-088 build. Check-Landing's 1000 ms gate works on fake records (a 1200 ms landing FAILs).

Fitness op=check (rebuilt): 69/69 rules hold, including the select-switch rule. SelectSwitchRuleTests pass in 503/503, and rules-parity AGREEs. The src grep finds no Process.Start, ProcessStartInfo, ShellExecute, explorer.exe or /select. The only reveal is ShellReveal.RevealAsync, called only at MainWindow.xaml.cs:775.

The test side is built as required, and its output now surfaces (O-016). Check-Landing records a failure when the hook logged Exact but no window shows the parent with the target as the only selection, and when the landing is over 1000 ms. That was verified on fake records under pwsh 7 and PS 5.1. It has never been executed against real Explorer on any SL-088 build. The product still reports Exact from the shell's answers, as designed. The open question about app-side confirmation is a person's to answer, not raised again here.

By code, SC-007's 'Open in Explorer' goes through this same reveal (MainWindow.xaml.cs:775, RevealAsync, Plan + Walk). This run's R-002 (e) drove that command through the published exe, on its refusal path. The existing SC-007 window cases (R-001) and the new ≥300-character landing steps (R-002 b/c/d) were not run.

R-002 step (e) passed through the fresh c26d3fe publish on the live desktop. gone\ was deleted after the scan. The victim.bin reveal gave Failed/NoLongerExists/0x80070002 with "'victim.bin' no longer exists where the scan found it, so Explorer was not opened. Rescan to refresh." Explorer showed no new, moved, re-selected or newly visible window, and the Shell.Application list was identical before and after.

obligations.evidence: Diff: Check-Landing's `return -1` became `return` and the trailing `$ms` is gone. The four R-002 call sites (b, a, c, d) call it plainly. The harness loaded it from the script's AST and fed it fake records. Under pwsh 7 and PS 5.1 its output is only check lines plus 'landed N ms after the click', with 0 non-string or bare-number outputs. A 1200 ms landing, a missing row and a non-landing each record exactly 1 failure with a FAIL line naming the check.

Get-ExplorerHwndCounts reads only .HWND per raw entry, and an unreadable one goes under 0. Close-CaseWindows requires no 0 key and a raw count equal to the case's own entries, checked twice. Harness in both shells: a case window alone or two case tabs alone are quit. Beside a readable, null-Document or failed-read person's tab, or while another entry's HWND is unreadable, nothing is quit and 1 entry is reported. A person's tab that joins between count and recount stops the quit; one that joins after the quit does not. The fake's thrown getters were swallowed by PowerShell, so the catch branches themselves were not exercised, only the null-read equivalents. Not exercised live: there was no tabbed window on the desktop.

The IsMisparsed/Plan code is unchanged since 41f82cc (the only src diff is a doc comment). At 41f82cc, con.txt, aux.h, nul.log, com1.txt, prn.md and lpt1.dat reached the open as Exact through the real shell with an exact resolve-back. Plan_UnusualAddressableNames_StaysExact passes in 503/503.

not_reached: R-002 steps a–d on any SL-088 build. Would show whether the deny-all short and 300-character folders and the 161/300/1000-character files actually land (parent folder plus a single selected item) through the shipped exe, and whether any #32770 dialog or consent.exe appears. A person runs `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case R-002`; a failure now names its step, check and landing ms.
R-001, the existing SC-007 reveal window cases, including the 300-character step 10: `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case R-001`.
Whether the cold first reveal (161 characters) lands within 1000 ms of the click with this code. The spikes' slowest landing was 934 ms, on the pre-SL-088 path.
Step (d) with Explorer already on the parent and a sibling selected: whether that window is reused, and whether only the target ends up selected.

Close-CaseWindows against a real tabbed Explorer window with 2+ entries, and whether Quit() on one tab's entry closes the tab or the whole window. Only a single-entry desktop was present, and the catch branches were not exercised because the fake's getter exceptions were swallowed.

This loop cannot close the gap. Three builds and three validations have stopped at the same person-only window run, and build 3 changed src only in a comment. Another send-back to build-slice will not change this verdict. A person running R-002 and R-001 will.
The actual Explorer landing on a volume without 8.3 names (D:). Only Walk up to the open was exercised there, at 41f82cc.
Windows 10: every check ran on Windows 11 26200 only.
Hidden+System reveals under Windows' default Explorer settings (Hidden=2): the spike is still waiting on a person.

A pre-existing Explorer window (HWND 723330) is open on a spike's temp tree (C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp\RVLE48~1\...). It was left untouched, and a person may want to close it before running R-002/R-001.
